title: CatsCraft
description: CatsCraft is a Survival, Creative, and Minigames server with a fun community of players!
body:
# 🐾 Welcome to CatsCraft 🐾

**CatsCraft** is a **Survival, Creative, and Minigames** Minecraft server where **everything is completely FREE** — including **WorldEdit and unlimited building space**.  

There are **no paid ranks**, meaning **everyone plays on equal ground** and the community comes first!

---

## 🌿 Survival Server

Our Survival world uses **Shovel Claim** protection to keep your builds safe and ensure a **no-griefing, relaxed survival experience**.

Along the way you can enjoy:

- 🎉 Seasonal holiday events  
- 🎁 Loot crates  
- 🎣 Fishing contests  
- ✨ Custom enchants  
- ⚔️ Fun challenges and more!

---

## 🏗️ Creative Server

Love to build? Our Creative world gives you the **tools and space to bring your ideas to life**.

Your **rank is based on the style and quality of builds you create**, so every build helps you progress.

---

## 🐱 Unique Rank System

Instead of pay-to-win ranks, **CatsCraft rewards active players**.

**📅 Rankups happen every Saturday at 5PM EST**

- **Survival:** Ranks are themed around **special cats** 🐈  
- **Creative:** Your **building skills determine your rank**

---

✨ Whether you want to **survive, create amazing builds, or hang out with a friendly community**, CatsCraft has a place for you.

**Join the fun and start your adventure today!**
